credits.production: Assembled locally (Pillow + ffmpeg) from sources generated with Higgsfield.
credits.realPhotographs: Two real photographs of company leaders (used with the owner's stated consent, including consent to AI animation), animated with AI (Kling 3.0 image-to-video) and shown in front of an AI-generated office; the animated scenes are AI output, not real footage
credits.stills: Seedream 5.0 Flash and GPT Image 2.6 (AI-generated illustration, animated with camera moves)
credits.videoShots: Kling 2.6 image-to-video (7 shots, 5 s each, 3 from the first film and 4 new); Kling 3.0 image-to-video from the two real photographs (4 clips of 5 s, silent)
credits.narration: Synthetic voice (Higgsfield Text to Speech V2, ElevenLabs engine, preset voice 'Alistair'); the owner's Arabic script, verbatim
credits.music: Generated instrumental (ElevenLabs Music v2 via Higgsfield); no third-party recordings
credits.logo: The official company logo file, composited as is

notes: Leaders appear from real photographs, animated with AI, in an AI-generated office; all other imagery is AI-generated illustration. It is not real footage of the company's factories, showrooms, projects or people; the leaders' scenes are AI animation, not real footage, and do not show real meetings or signed agreements.
Landmarks (Manama skyline, causeway, fort, Tree of Life) are AI-generated illustrations, not photographs. Projects named in the narration are shown only as generic AI-generated imagery.
Information only, not an offer or financial advice; details provided directly by management.

Figures stated (more than 50,000 projects, more than 27 patents, two factories, distribution agreements across the Gulf, Iraq and Jordan) are the owner's script; see docs/showroom3d/JOURNEY-V2-FACTS.md for the figures to confirm.
Full storyboard, ledger and wiring change: docs/showroom3d/JOURNEY-V4.md
